verdict.rationale: Stating covered filings, states, and price before purchase is a fair axis for a compliance filing service, so it applies. The pack has no evidence that CT Corporation publishes this. The only items are probes: the main host returns a Cloudflare challenge even for robots.txt, and the legacy host redirects into that walled host, so no coverage list or price disclosure was observable.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the filing service states which filings and states it covers and what it costs before I buy it
